target_semantics: Current candidate invalidation target for the 2026-11-07 holdout. The historical baseline_sha and CONFIRMED evidence are retained as historical facts, not as a current candidate PASS.

known_issue_resolution_tracking.policy: Historical CONFIRMED claims about defects observed on the 2c108dda iPhone run are immutable. A repaired behavior is represented by a NEW resolution record referencing the original claim; RESOLVED is not a claim.status, and does not overwrite or erase the historical claim.

outcome_semantics.RESOLVED: A qualifying test scene occurred in the frozen candidate runtime, the original issue no longer appears, and device/runtime evidence plus independent human-facing review confirms the correction. Add a new record with the exact observed evidence.
outcome_semantics.REVERIFY_REQUIRED: Default until a qualifying device scene and evidence are available, including when the holdout only demonstrates runtime asset identity.
outcome_semantics.UNRESOLVED: Evidence contradicts the expected correction or exposes the original issue; report the observed behavior without modifying the historical claim.

issue_specific_acceptance.SV-KNOWN-COACH-ALT-LABEL-001: A TRADE_OFF with multiple alternatives is displayed; each directional advantage is explicitly attributed to its own candidate, without contradictory flattened reasons.
issue_specific_acceptance.SV-KNOWN-COACH-ACTION-PHRASE-001: A confirmed multi-step card play plus evolution (or equivalent same-card chain) occurs and its displayed description is natural and avoids repeated card name/comma-chaining.
issue_specific_acceptance.SV-KNOWN-EP-PRESENTATION-001: A same-run pre-action EP carry occurs while raw before-state EP remains unknown; the Review Card displays the carried value and its source/provenance without replacing the raw before-state.

known_issue_resolution_tracking.verification_rule: Do not infer RESOLVED from code diffs, automated tests, 20/20 runtime asset matching, or a scene where the target condition never occurs. Record no resolution when a qualifying scene is absent. The holdout may independently PASS on structural/no-wrong-coach criteria while these three issues stay REVERIFY_REQUIRED.
known_issue_resolution_tracking.source_requirement: For the 2026-11-07 original recording, collect replaySessionV1.analysisRun.sourceKey from the same diagnostic and compare against video metadata. It is not cryptographic identity; compare actual gameplay with the compressed Oracle before using it as cross-source evidence.
